history.name: Recording a product-wide change
history.description: The command ledger other-change records something that runs across the whole product, such as a wording pass over many screens or a change in what a colour means. It prints once at the end of the edition, under the heading Also since last time, instead of forcing the same note onto a dozen unrelated entries.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs cmdOtherChange, stored in .ledger/other-changes.json with a version and an audience.

history.description: The command ledger note records something that runs across the whole product, such as a wording pass over many screens or a change in what a colour means. It prints once at the end of the edition, under the heading Also since last time, instead of forcing the same note onto a dozen unrelated entries.
changes: The command was ledger other-change. It is now ledger note, which names what it records; the old name still works and says what it is called now.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs cmdOtherChange, stored in .ledger/other-changes.json with a version and an audience. `ledger other-change` is an alias in src/cli.mjs.
